fullText.simplified:
第一章、我叫屈原

    你好！我叫屈原，来自2300多年前的中国。
    你听说过中国的端午节吗？我的名字和这个节日有很深的联系。每年端午节，人们都会举行划龙船、吃粽子的活动，其实都是为了纪念我。
    我喜欢写诗，一生写了很多诗歌。后人把我写的诗歌放进一本书里，这本书叫《楚辞》。《楚辞》和另一本叫《诗经》的书，都是中国非常古老的诗歌集，是中国文学的两大源头。
    1953年，世界和平理事会评选四位“世界文化名人”，我是其中之一。
    别人记得我，我很感激。但最让我高兴的是，后人理解了我的理想，并把它当作中国“家国精神”的重要组成部分。
    “家国精神”这个词，听起来好像有点不太好理解。不过没关系，读完我的故事，你会明白它的意思。
    在开始读故事之前，请你先在心里画一幅古老的中国地图。
    那是2300多年前的中国，后人叫这一时期为“战国末期”，当时这儿有七个主要的国家：
    西方是秦国——很强大
    东方是齐国——也很强大
    南方是楚国——面积最大
    北方和中间还有四个小国：燕国、赵国、韩国、魏国。
    我知道，一下子要记住七个古老国家的名字可能不太容易。因此，你不需要马上就记住它们。在读故事的过程中，你自然会慢慢熟悉它们。
    我们可以先做一件有趣的事：请在纸上画一幅简单的地图，只标出西边的秦国、东边的齐国和南边的楚国，然后把其他四个小国放在中间和北方。
    有了这幅地图，你再读我的故事，理解起来就会容易很多。
    好了，你准备好了吗？我的故事，现在开始了。
fullText.traditional:
第一章、我叫屈原

    你好！我叫屈原，來自2300多年前的中國。
    你聽說過中國的端午節嗎？我的名字和這個節日有很深的聯繫。每年端午節，人們都會舉行划龍船、吃粽子的活動，其實都是為了紀念我。
    我喜歡寫詩，一生寫了很多詩歌。後人把我寫的詩歌放進一本書裡，這本書叫《楚辭》。《楚辭》和另一本叫《詩經》的書，都是中國非常古老的詩歌集，是中國文學的兩大源頭。
    1953年，世界和平理事會評選四位“世界文化名人”，我是其中之一。
    別人記得我，我很感激。但最讓我高興的是，後人理解了我的理想，並把它當作中國“家國精神”的重要組成部分。
    “家國精神”這個詞，聽起來好像有點不太好理解。不過沒關係，讀完我的故事，你會明白它的意思。
    在開始讀故事之前，請你先在心裡畫一幅古老的中國地圖。
    那是2300多年前的中國，後人叫這一時期為“戰國末期”，當時這兒有七個主要的國家：
    西方是秦國——很強大
    東方是齊國——也很強大
    南方是楚國——面積最大
    北方和中間還有四個小國：燕國、趙國、韓國、魏國。
    我知道，一下子要記住七個古老國家的名字可能不太容易。因此，你不需要馬上就記住它們。在讀故事的過程中，你自然會慢慢熟悉它們。
    我們可以先做一件有趣的事：請在紙上畫一幅簡單的地圖，只標出西邊的秦國、東邊的齊國和南邊的楚國，然後把其他四個小國放在中間和北方。
    有了這幅地圖，你再讀我的故事，理解起來就會容易很多。
    好了，你準備好了嗎？我的故事，現在開始了。

sentences.simplified: 你好！我叫屈原，来自2300多年前的中国。
sentences.traditional: 你好！我叫屈原，來自2300多年前的中國。
sentences.pinyin: nǐ hǎo wǒ jiào qū yuán lái zì duō nián qián de zhōng guó
sentences.english: Hello! My name is Qu Yuan, and I come from China more than 2,300 years ago.

sentences.simplified: 你听说过中国的端午节吗？我的名字和这个节日有很深的联系。
sentences.traditional: 你聽說過中國的端午節嗎？我的名字和這個節日有很深的聯繫。
sentences.pinyin: nǐ tīng shuō guò zhōng guó de duān wǔ jié ma wǒ de míng zi hé zhè ge jié rì yǒu hěn shēn de lián xì
sentences.english: Have you heard of China’s Dragon Boat Festival? My name is deeply connected with this festival.

sentences.simplified: 每年端午节，人们都会举行划龙船、吃粽子的活动，其实都是为了纪念我。
sentences.traditional: 每年端午節，人們都會舉行划龍船、吃粽子的活動，其實都是為了紀念我。
sentences.pinyin: měi nián duān wǔ jié rén men dōu huì jǔ xíng huá lóng chuán chī zòng zi de huó dòng qí shí dōu shì wèi le jì niàn wǒ
sentences.english: Every year during the Dragon Boat Festival, people hold dragon boat races and eat zongzi, all to commemorate me.

sentences.simplified: 我喜欢写诗，一生写了很多诗歌。
sentences.traditional: 我喜歡寫詩，一生寫了很多詩歌。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ xǐ huan xiě shī yì shēng xiě le hěn duō shī gē
sentences.english: I love writing poetry, and wrote many poems throughout my life.

sentences.simplified: 后人把我写的诗歌放进一本书里，这本书叫《楚辞》。
sentences.traditional: 後人把我寫的詩歌放進一本書裡，這本書叫《楚辭》。
sentences.pinyin: hòu rén bǎ wǒ xiě de shī gē fàng jìn yì běn shū lǐ zhè běn shū jiào chǔ cí
sentences.english: Later generations compiled my poems into a book called the “Songs of Chu”.

sentences.simplified: 《楚辞》和另一本叫《诗经》的书，都是中国非常古老的诗歌集，
sentences.traditional: 《楚辭》和另一本叫《詩經》的書，都是中國非常古老的詩歌集，
sentences.pinyin: chǔ cí hé lìng yī běn jiào shī jīng de shū dōu shì zhōng guó fēi cháng gǔ lǎo de shī gē jí
sentences.english: The “Songs of Chu” and another book, called the “Book of Songs”, are both very ancient collections of Chinese poetry.

sentences.simplified: 是中国文学的两大源头。
sentences.traditional: 是中國文學的兩大源頭。
sentences.pinyin: shì zhōng guó wén xué de liǎng dà yuán tóu
sentences.english: They are the two major fountainheads of Chinese literature.

sentences.simplified: 1953年，世界和平理事会评选四位“世界文化名人”，我是其中之一。
sentences.traditional: 1953年，世界和平理事會評選四位“世界文化名人”，我是其中之一。
sentences.pinyin: nián shì jiè hé píng lǐ shì huì píng xuǎn sì wèi shì jiè wén huà míng rén wǒ shì qí zhōng zhī yī
sentences.english: In 1953, the World Peace Council selected four “World Cultural Celebrities”, and I was one of them.

sentences.simplified: 别人记得我，我很感激。
sentences.traditional: 別人記得我，我很感激。
sentences.pinyin: bié rén jì de wǒ wǒ hěn gǎn jī
sentences.english: I am grateful that people remember me.

sentences.simplified: 但最让我高兴的是，后人理解了我的理想，
sentences.traditional: 但最讓我高興的是，後人理解了我的理想，
sentences.pinyin: dàn zuì ràng wǒ gāo xìng de shì hòu rén lǐ jiě le wǒ de lǐ xiǎng
sentences.english: But what makes me happiest is that later generations understood my ideals, ..

sentences.simplified: 并把它当作中国“家国精神”的重要组成部分。
sentences.traditional: 並把它當作中國“家國精神”的重要組成部分。
sentences.pinyin: bìng bǎ tā dàng zuò zhōng guó jiā guó jīng shén de zhòng yào zǔ chéng bù fen
sentences.english: .. and regarded them as an important part of China’s “spirit of home and country”.

sentences.simplified: “家国精神”这个词，听起来好像有点不太好理解。
sentences.traditional: “家國精神”這個詞，聽起來好像有點不太好理解。
sentences.pinyin: jiā guó jīng shén zhè ge cí tīng qǐ lái hǎo xiàng yǒu diǎn bú tài hǎo lǐ jiě
sentences.english: The term “spirit of home and country” might sound a bit difficult to understand.

sentences.simplified: 不过没关系，读完我的故事，你会明白它的意思。
sentences.traditional: 不過沒關係，讀完我的故事，你會明白它的意思。
sentences.pinyin: bú guò méi guān xi dú wán wǒ de gù shi nǐ huì míng bai tā de yì si
sentences.english: But don’t worry. After reading my story, you will understand its meaning.

sentences.simplified: 在开始读故事之前，请你先在心里画一幅古老的中国地图。
sentences.traditional: 在開始讀故事之前，請你先在心裡畫一幅古老的中國地圖。
sentences.pinyin: zài kāi shǐ dú gù shi zhī qián qǐng nǐ xiān zài xīn lǐ huà yì fú gǔ lǎo de zhōng guó dì tú
sentences.english: Before you start reading my story, please first draw a map of ancient China in your mind.

sentences.simplified: 那是2300多年前的中国，后人叫这一时期为“战国末期”，
sentences.traditional: 那是2300多年前的中國，後人叫這一時期為“戰國末期”，
sentences.pinyin: nà shì duō nián qián de zhōng guó hòu rén jiào zhè yì shí qī wéi zhàn guó mò qī
sentences.english: This was China over 2,300 years ago, a period later generations called the “late Warring States period”.

sentences.simplified: 当时这儿有七个主要的国家：
sentences.traditional: 當時這兒有七個主要的國家：
sentences.pinyin: dāng shí zhè‘r yǒu qī ge zhǔ yào de guó jiā
sentences.english: At the time, there were seven major states:

sentences.simplified: 西方是秦国——很强大
sentences.traditional: 西方是秦國——很強大
sentences.pinyin: xī fāng shì qín guó hěn qiáng dà
sentences.english: In the west was the state of Qin—very powerful.

sentences.simplified: 东方是齐国——也很强大
sentences.traditional: 東方是齊國——也很強大
sentences.pinyin: dōng fāng shì qí guó yě hěn qiáng dà
sentences.english: In the east was the state of Qi—also very powerful.

sentences.simplified: 南方是楚国——面积最大
sentences.traditional: 南方是楚國——面積最大
sentences.pinyin: nán fāng shì chǔ guó miàn jī zuì dà
sentences.english: In the south was the state of Chu—the largest in terms of area.

sentences.simplified: 北方和中间还有四个小国：燕国、赵国、韩国、魏国。
sentences.traditional: 北方和中間還有四個小國：燕國、趙國、韓國、魏國。
sentences.pinyin: běi fāng hé zhōng jiān hái yǒu sì ge xiǎo guó yān guó zhào guó hán guó wèi guó
sentences.english: In the north and center were four smaller states: the state of Yan, the state of Zhao, the state of Han, and the state of Wei.

sentences.simplified: 我知道，一下子要记住七个古老国家的名字可能不太容易。
sentences.traditional: 我知道，一下子要記住七個古老國家的名字可能不太容易。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ zhī dào yí xià zi yào jì zhu qī ge gǔ lǎo guó jiā de míng zi kě néng bú tài róng yì
sentences.english: I know that remembering the names of seven ancient states all at once might not be easy.

sentences.simplified: 因此，你不需要马上就记住它们。在读故事的过程中，你自然会慢慢熟悉它们。
sentences.traditional: 因此，你不需要馬上就記住它們。在讀故事的過程中，你自然會慢慢熟悉它們。
sentences.pinyin: yīn cǐ nǐ bù xū yào mǎ shàng jiù jì zhu tā men zài dú gù shi de guò chéng zhōng nǐ zì rán huì màn man shú xī tā men
sentences.english: So you don’t need to remember them right away. As you read the story, you will naturally become familiar with them.

sentences.simplified: 我们可以先做一件有趣的事：
sentences.traditional: 我們可以先做一件有趣的事：
sentences.pinyin: wǒ men kě yǐ xiān zuò yí jiàn yǒu qù de shì
sentences.english: We can do something fun first:

sentences.simplified: 请在纸上画一幅简单的地图，只标出西边的秦国、东边的齐国和南边的楚国，
sentences.traditional: 請在紙上畫一幅簡單的地圖，只標出西邊的秦國、東邊的齊國和南邊的楚國，
sentences.pinyin: qǐng zài zhǐ shang huà yì fú jiǎn dān de dì tú zhǐ biāo chū xī biān de qín guó dōng bian de qí guó hé nán bian de chǔ guó
sentences.english: Draw a simple map on paper, marking only the state of Qin in the west, the state of Qi in the east, and the state of Chu in the south.

sentences.simplified: 然后把其他四个小国放在中间和北方。
sentences.traditional: 然後把其他四個小國放在中間和北方。
sentences.pinyin: rán hòu bǎ qí tā sì ge xiǎo guó fàng zài zhōng jiān hé běi fāng
sentences.english: Then, place the other four smaller states in the center and north.

sentences.simplified: 有了这幅地图，你再读我的故事，理解起来就会容易很多。
sentences.traditional: 有了這幅地圖，你再讀我的故事，理解起來就會容易很多。
sentences.pinyin: yǒu le zhè fú dì tú nǐ zài dú wǒ de gù shi lǐ jiě qǐ lái jiù huì róng yì hěn duō
sentences.english: With this map, it will be much easier to understand my story as you read it.

sentences.simplified: 好了，你准备好了吗？我的故事，现在开始了。
sentences.traditional: 好了，你準備好了嗎？我的故事，現在開始了。
sentences.pinyin: hǎo le nǐ zhǔn bèi hǎo le ma wǒ de gù shi xiàn zài kāi shǐ le
sentences.english: All right, are you ready? My story begins now.

sentence_translations: Chapter 1: My Name is Qu Yuan
Hello! My name is Qu Yuan, and I come from China more than 2,300 years ago.
Have you heard of China’s Dragon Boat Festival? My name is deeply connected with this festival.
Every year during the Dragon Boat Festival, people hold dragon boat races and eat zongzi, all to commemorate me.
I love writing poetry, and wrote many poems throughout my life.
Later generations compiled my poems into a book called the “Songs of Chu”.
The “Songs of Chu” and another book, called the “Book of Songs”, are both very ancient collections of Chinese poetry.
They are the two major fountainheads of Chinese literature.
In 1953, the World Peace Council selected four “World Cultural Celebrities”, and I was one of them.
I am grateful that people remember me.
But what makes me happiest is that later generations understood my ideals, ..
.. and regarded them as an important part of China’s “spirit of home and country”.
The term “spirit of home and country” might sound a bit difficult to understand.
But don’t worry. After reading my story, you will understand its meaning.
Before you start reading my story, please first draw a map of ancient China in your mind.
This was China over 2,300 years ago, a period later generations called the “late Warring States period”.
At the time, there were seven major states:
In the west was the state of Qin—very powerful.
In the east was the state of Qi—also very powerful.
In the south was the state of Chu—the largest in terms of area.
In the north and center were four smaller states: the state of Yan, the state of Zhao, the state of Han, and the state of Wei.
I know that remembering the names of seven ancient states all at once might not be easy.
So you don’t need to remember them right away. As you read the story, you will naturally become familiar with them.
We can do something fun first:
Draw a simple map on paper, marking only the state of Qin in the west, the state of Qi in the east, and the state of Chu in the south.
Then, place the other four smaller states in the center and north.
With this map, it will be much easier to understand my story as you read it.
All right, are you ready? My story begins now.
